mainText:
Good afternoon. Weather in Prishtina: 9 degrees now, moderate rain. Next 24 hours: high 9, low 4.

A 32-year-old Kosovar was arrested by German federal police at the A8 border near Freilassing, after serving 1,138 days of a prison sentence.

The "Hamdi Kurteshi" road project in Gjilan is nearing completion, with a total investment of 2.36 million euros announced by Infrastructure Minister Dimal Basha.

Gëzim Berisha, director of Mitrovica General Hospital, has been detained on suspicion of domestic violence against his wife.

About 1,500 police officers have been deployed for today's student protest in Tirana, which remains calm outside the Ministry of Education and the Prime Minister's office.

Chelsea and Manchester United have released their official line-ups for the Premier League derby scheduled this week.
